'''Wing packs''' were a type of [[Glider (vehicle)/Legends|glider]] in use on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Solay]]. The packs were used in conjunction with a [[jump platform]] to glide across the landscapes of Solay. After strapping on a wing pack, an individual would be propelled into the air by a jump platform and would then activate the wing pack, which would release two large wings. The release mechanism was controlled by a pull cord on the side, which the wearer yanked at the top of his or her jump.

Around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] employed a wing pack to pursue the fleeing ex-[[King/Legends|King]] [[Blackart]]. Skywalker used the pack to glide in front of Blackart's [[Solay rocket ship|rocket ship]], where he disabled the rocket with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].
